objective: 0.3.0 pi 10/10: Cover the Pi integration in CI and on Windows, so the required checks fail when the Pi package is stale or broken on any supported platform.
requirements: Maintainer (verbatim): "please add intents for the next 0.3.0 release where I will implement the pi extension integration"; the maintainer implements 0.3.0, so these Intents record the work and carry no Assignments until the maintainer starts it.
Maintainer (verbatim): "in the docs/pi/ it's supposed to use already existent extensions for required functionality" and "the first provider to implement will be kimi for coding global".

Release model: work lands on release/0.3.0/integration cut from main, as one release/0.3.0/<type>/<change> branch and one PR per change; the first PR of the release carries the version bump made with mise run bump:minor.
Done means mise run verify passes with the generated output in sync (mise run build) and CI green on every required check, including the windows job.
The check job's generated-output freshness check covers the Pi package, and the windows job runs the Pi tests.
Extension and launcher code that runs on Windows calls the bundled CLI through Bun on holyagent.js directly, not through the POSIX sh wrapper.
Child launches and paths work on native Windows, where Pi's built-in tool list includes powershell beside bash.
Workflow and dependency tests still pass: pinned action SHAs with version comments, caret dependency ranges, the path-length test.
A contract test covers the Pi RPC or JSON events the integration consumes (agent_settled, tool events, extension_ui_request) against the pinned Pi version.

Decided (maintainer): CI replays recorded pi events for the pinned pi version (fixtures), re-recorded when deps:update moves pi; the pi tests run inside the existing check and windows jobs, so no ruleset change.
